AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.title: The Silent Assembly Line
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.INI:
The conveyor has been still for decades, yet the assembly arms light up one by one the moment they recognize your chassis.

"Aurora unit. Identity confirmed. Awaiting final armament configuration."

A sharp fire-control unit rises on the left cradle; a cracked shield core unfolds on the right. The line still believes the war never ended.
Lose 8% of your Max HP. Gain an upgraded Deploy: Blade. Deploy an Attack Module at the start of your next combat.
Lose 8% of your Max HP. Gain an upgraded Deploy: Bulwark. Deploy a Shield Module at the start of your next combat.
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.FIR: The arms lock the armament into your auxiliary hardpoint. Old targeting lines search for an enemy once more.
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.BUL: The shield core hums low. For the first time, the line has given you something not made to kill.
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.CUT: The arms freeze midair. The last assembly line finally ends its war.
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.INI: The line does not recognize your chassis. Leave.
AURORAMOD-SILENT_ASSEMBLY_LINE.pages.LEA: The arms lower in silence. You are not the chassis it was waiting for.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.title: The Redline Test Reactor
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.INI:
Something still turns deep inside the reactor. Only one warning blinks on the console, over and over:

"Safety valve not released. Peak output never verified."

The core is waiting for a chassis that can endure the redline. Perhaps it has been waiting for you.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.upgradePr: Choose up to 2 cards to Upgrade.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.INI: Upgrade up to 2 cards. Gain 11 Heat at the start of your next combat.
Pay 60 Gold. Heal 25% of your Max HP.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.REL: The core crosses the redline. Every flaw in the old design is burned into a new answer.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.DRA: Coolant floods the armor layers. The reactor goes dark, and your wounds close in the cold.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.SEA: You weld the hatch shut again. Some tests are left unfinished — perhaps that is its own kind of luck.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.INI: The core does not answer to you. Leave.
AURORAMOD-REDLINE_TEST_REACTOR.pages.LEA: The warning keeps blinking. This core was not waiting for you.
AURORAMOD-ARCHIVE_OF_THE_LAST_WAR.title: Archive of the Last War
A command core, still running, recognizes you.

Two sets of records surface on the screen: a swordsman standing alone at the center of the battlefield, waiting for a single strike; and countless commands linked end to end, until the whole line becomes one continuous flash.

Every record ends with the same line: "The enemy no longer exists. Continue execution."
AURORAMOD-ARCHIVE_OF_THE_LAST_WAR.remove: Choose 1 card to remove from your deck.
Lose 8% of your Max HP. Choose 1 of 3 random Common/Uncommon Momentum cards to add to your deck. Gain 4 Momentum at the start of your next combat.
Lose 8% of your Max HP. Choose 1 of 3 random Common/Uncommon Chain cards to add to your deck. Draw 2 extra cards and gain 2 Heat at the start of your next combat.
Lose 5 Max HP. Remove 1 card from your deck.
You remember how to wait — not out of hesitation, but because that single strike only needs to land once.
The old commands rearrange themselves. Hundreds of long-dead voices wait once more for your next order.
You delete the last command. Memory grows incomplete, yet for the first time it is truly quiet.
The command core does not recognize you. Leave.
The screen goes dark. These records were not kept for you.
